title: Full Body Strength Foundation - Return to Training

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly through each position, synchronizing breath with movement. Arch and round the spine deliberately to warm up the entire kinetic chain.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Rotate hips smoothly between positions, keeping chest upright. This opens the hip joint and prepares lower body for loading.

items.name: Banded Shoulder Dislocates
items.cues: Use a light resistance band with a wide grip. Move in a controlled arc from front to back, mobilizing shoulder joint through full range of motion.

items.name: Back Squat
items.cues: Keep chest up, core engaged. Drive through heels as you stand. Achieve depth where hip crease is at or below knee level. Control the descent.

items.name: Bench Press
items.cues: Retract shoulder blades, maintain neutral spine against bench. Lower weight to mid-chest, elbows at 45-degree angle. Press powerfully back to start.

items.name: Bent Over Row
items.cues: Hinge at hips with slight knee bend, flat back. Row weight to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades together at top. Control the descent.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.cues: Rear foot elevated on bench. Lower into split squat with front knee tracking over ankle. Push through front heel to stand. Maintain upright torso throughout.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Step one foot back, heel planted, lean forward gently. Feel stretch in calf muscle. Hold steady, breathe deeply.

items.name: Child's Pose
items.cues: Kneel and sink hips back to heels, extend arms forward. Relax completely, focus on deep breathing and mental reset.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place forearm against wall, thumb pointing up. Rotate body away gently to feel stretch in biceps and shoulder. Hold and breathe.

items.name: Prone Thoracic Rotation
items.cues: Lie on side with knees bent. Open top arm across body, rotating upper back. Slow, controlled movement to mobilize spine gently post-workout.

rationale: User is returning to training after 999 days (extended rest), so intensity starts at RPE 6-7 with moderate weights to rebuild baseline strength safely without overloading joints or connective tissue.

Full body strength session targeting major movement patterns (squat, horizontal press, row, single-leg) with 50-minute duration suitable for intermediate fitness level using available barbell and dumbbell equipment.
Extended warmup with mobility focus prepares joints and nervous system after prolonged inactivity, while cooldown emphasizes recovery and tissue quality to support adaptation and reduce soreness.
